business_problem: Home Credit needed to reduce contact-center operating costs, keep service levels stable during pandemic disruption, and standardize telemarketing, collections, and customer-service interactions as part of a broader digital-transformation program.
solution_summary: Home Credit and Baidu AI Cloud built an Intelligent Customer Service 2.0 stack that spans telemarketing, collections, and customer-service workflows. The deployment starts with Baidu's language-understanding layer, which classifies user intent, emotion, and attitude so each call can be routed into the right conversation flow. On top of that, a task-oriented conversation engine manages entity substitution, clarification, pronoun resolution, and guided prompts to make automated dialogues feel more natural. Voice robots then handle high-volume service work, which proved critical when pandemic disruption reduced available agents. In collections, the platform enforces standardized scripts and can play different voices for different customer situations, while human agents focus on harder exceptions. The result is a shared AI service layer that improves efficiency and supports Home Credit's online-plus-offline digital-transformation strategy.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Customer Service 2.0
solution_components.role: Provides the frontline automation layer for Home Credit's telemarketing, collections, and customer-service conversations.

solution_components.name: Language Understanding
solution_components.role: Recognizes customer intent, emotion, and attitude so the platform can choose the right response flow.

solution_components.name: Task-oriented Conversation Engine
solution_components.role: Controls the dialogue logic for entity filling, clarification, coreference handling, and guided conversation steps.

solution_components.name: Voice Robot Service
solution_components.role: Handles high-volume automated voice interactions and standardized collection scripts when demand spikes or staffing is constrained.

data_flow: Calls from telemarketing, collections, and customer-service channels enter the intelligent customer-service layer, where language-understanding models classify intent and sentiment. The task-oriented engine then selects the right flow, fills entities and clarifications, and the voice-robot service delivers standardized responses or passes complex cases to human agents.
business_outcome: Home Credit maintained service continuity during pandemic disruption, fully standardized AI collections talk tracks, improved intent recognition, reduced labor cost, and strengthened the digital foundation for wider omnichannel financial-service operations.
architecture_clues: The same platform spans telemarketing, collections, and customer-service workflows.
